default_message: The API key isn't valid. Check that you copied all of it (it starts with dg_live_ or dg_test_), or create a new one in Console › Agents.
The API key has been revoked. Create a new key in Console › Agents.
The API key expired after it was rolled. Use the new key, or create one in Console › Agents.
template: The API key expired at {time} UTC after it was rolled. Use the new key, or create one in Console › Agents.

default_message: This agent is suspended. An admin can resume it in Console › Agents.
template: Agent "{name}" is suspended. An admin can resume it in Console › Agents.

default_message: This agent is stopped. Deedglass refuses its calls until an admin starts it in Console › Agents.
template: Agent "{name}" is stopped. Deedglass refuses its calls until an admin starts it in Console › Agents.

default_message: All agents in this org are stopped. An owner can start them again in Console › Settings.
template: All agents in {org} are stopped. An owner can start them again in Console › Settings.

default_message: This key doesn't have the scope this endpoint needs. Create a key with that scope in Console › Agents.
template: This key doesn't have the {scope} scope. Create a key with {scope} in Console › Agents.

default_message: Blocked by policy. The action in Console › Actions names the rule and the reason.
template: Blocked by policy "{rule}": {reason}.

default_message: This action needs approval. It runs once someone approves it in Console › Approvals.
This approval expired before anyone decided. Nothing ran. Ask the agent to try again if it's still needed.
template: This approval expired at {time}. Nothing ran. Ask the agent to try again if it's still needed.

default_message: This agent has used its budget for the period. It resets when the next period starts, or an admin can raise it.
template: This agent has used its budget for the period. It resets at {time}, or an admin can raise it.

default_message: This agent must sign its requests. Send a Deedglass-Intent header.
The signed intent doesn't match this request. Sign the exact tool and arguments you send.
This signed intent was already used. Sign a new one with a fresh nonce.
No connector provides this tool. Check the name, or add a connector in Console › Connectors.
template: No tool named "{tool}". Tools look like "connector.tool", for example "fake.echo".

default_message: The connector isn't reachable right now. Check Console › Connectors, then retry.
The tool returned an error. The details are on the action in Console › Actions.
The request timed out. It may have partly run, so fetch the object to see its state before you send it again.
template: The request timed out after {n} s. It may have partly run, so fetch the object to see its state before you send it again.

default_message: Too many requests. Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.
template: Too many requests. Retry after {n} s.

default_message: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. Use a new key for a new request.
A field in the request isn't valid. The param field names it.
template: {field-specific sentence}.

default_message: There's no object with that id in this org. Check the id.
template: There's no {object} with id {id}. / There's no endpoint at {METHOD} {path}. Did you mean {p}?

default_message: That conflicts with the current state. Fetch the latest version, then retry.
Something went wrong on our side. It's logged under this request id. Retry, and share the id if it happens again.
This endpoint needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer dg_live_…) or a Console session.
This method isn't supported on this path. The Allow header lists the ones that are.
template: {METHOD} isn't supported on {path}. Use {allowed}.

default_message: The request body is too large for this endpoint. Send a smaller body.
template: The request body is larger than {limit}. Send a smaller body.

default_message: Send the body as JSON, with Content-Type: application/json.
The body isn't valid JSON. Fix it and retry.
template: The body isn't valid JSON (line {l}, column {c}). Fix it and retry.

default_message: Deedglass-Version isn't a known version. Use 2026-10-01, or leave it out to use your org's pinned version.
Idempotency-Key must be 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.
A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. Retry in a moment.
Deedglass is starting or shutting down. Retry in a few seconds.
Your session ended. Sign in again.
template: Your session ended after 12 hours without activity. Sign in again at {base}/login.

default_message: This request is missing its security token. Reload the page and try again.
Your role in this org doesn't allow this. Ask an owner to change your role.
template: Your role in {org} is {Role}, and {what} needs {MinRole}. Ask an owner to change your role.

default_message: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Get a new one at /login.
template: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Get a new one at {base}/login.

default_message: That code doesn't match, or it has expired. Check the latest email, or get a new code.
This org needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
template: {org} needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

default_message: Deedglass could not evaluate the policy for this action, so it did not run. An admin can check Console › Policies.
The policy wasn't accepted. The diagnostics list each problem with its line and a hint.
template: The policy has {n} errors. The first is on line {line}: {message}.

default_message: This connector has no credentials yet. Store them with deedglass connector credentials set, then retry.
template: The connector "{name}" has no credentials yet. Run deedglass connector credentials set {name} --from-env {NAME}_TOKEN.

default_message: The connector's destination is blocked by Deedglass's network rules. An admin can see why in Console › Connectors.
template: base_url resolves to {ip}, {a class}. Deedglass never connects to it. Use the service's public address.

default_message: Deedglass couldn't open this connector's credentials. An admin has been alerted.
template: {n} credentials use {kek_id}, which isn't in DEEDGLASS_VAULT_KEY. Add it back as the second key, restart, then run deedglass vault rotate.

default_message: The service refused the connector's credentials. An admin can replace them in Console › Connectors.
The service has nothing at that address. Check the arguments.
The service is limiting requests. Wait, then send the call again.
The service answered with more than the connector's max_response_bytes, so Deedglass kept none of it. The call ran.
Refused by the Postgres connector. Deedglass runs one plain statement per action, and never transaction control, schema changes or schema deedglass.
template: Refused by the Postgres connector: the statement has {n} commands. Deedglass runs one statement per action.

default_message: The statement changed more rows than this connector allows. Nothing was committed. Narrow the WHERE clause.
template: The statement changed {n} rows, over this connector's limit of {max}. Nothing was committed. Narrow the WHERE clause.

default_message: The connector's database role is a superuser. Deedglass refuses to run agent SQL with it. Run deedglass connector postgres init to create deedglass_agent.
Deedglass isn't set up in this database yet. Run deedglass connector postgres init.
template: Deedglass isn't set up in this database yet. Run deedglass connector postgres init --connector {name}.

default_message: This connector isn't witnessed, so it has no decoder. Turn on witness.enabled in its config first.
template: The connector "{name}" isn't witnessed. Set witness.enabled to true in its config, then run deedglass connector postgres check {name}.

default_message: This approval was already decided. Console › Approvals shows who decided and when.
template: This approval was already decided: {outcome} by {name} at {time}.

default_message: You already countersigned this. It needs another person.
template: You already countersigned this. It needs {n} more {person}.

default_message: You're not an approver for this rule. Ask one of its approvers to countersign.
template: Rule "{rule}" needs {approvers} to countersign. Ask one of them.

default_message: This action runs on your behalf, so another approver has to countersign it. You can still deny it.
Approvals need a person. Agents and API keys can't countersign. Use Console › Approvals or the emailed link.
What you reviewed is out of date. Reload the approval and review it again.
No one in this org can approve this, so it did not run. Invite another admin, or allow self-countersign in Console › Settings › Approvals.
template: No one in this org can approve this: the rule needs {n} people and only {m} {is} eligible. Nothing was run. Invite another admin, or allow self-countersign in Console › Settings › Approvals.

default_message: This approval link has expired or was already used. Open Console › Approvals.
Your org decides approvals in the Console. Open Console › Approvals to countersign.
No person in this org matches that Slack account. Invite them in Console › Settings › Members.
This is a live-mode Stripe key. Deedglass connects to Stripe sandboxes only. Use a restricted key that starts with rk_test_.
The stripe connector is disabled. An admin has been alerted.
template: Stripe answered in live mode for request {req}. Deedglass disabled the {name} connector. Check the request in your Stripe dashboard, then replace the key with a sandbox key.

default_message: Stripe is holding this for its own approval. Deedglass can't see whether a Stripe reviewer approves it. Check Settings › Approvals in Stripe.
template: Stripe is holding this refund for its own approval ({apreq}). Deedglass can't see whether a Stripe reviewer approves it. Check Settings › Approvals in Stripe.

default_message: Undo isn't available for this action. The checks field lists each failing check with its fix.
template: Undo isn't available for {act}: {n} check failed ({ids}). Run deedglass undo preview {act} for the fix.

default_message: The rows changed since you previewed this undo. Preview it again and use the new plan.
This action was already undone, or an undo of it is waiting. Look at the action's undo object.
template: {act} was already undone by {undo} at {time}. / An undo of {act} is already waiting for approval: {undo}.

default_message: A row changed after the undo's plan was made, so Postgres rolled the undo back. Nothing was changed. Preview the undo again.
template: Row {table} {key} changed after the plan was made ({column} is now {value}). Nothing was changed. Preview the undo again.

default_message: This replay covers more than 1,000,000 actions. Narrow the window with from and to.
template: This replay covers {n} actions; the limit is 1,000,000. Narrow the window with from and to.

default_message: The window must start before it ends, and it can be at most 90 days long. Send from before to.
The policy changed since this suggestion was written. Generate suggestions again: POST /v1/suggestions/generate.
template: {policy} v{now} has been enforced since this suggestion was written for v{base}. Generate suggestions again: POST /v1/suggestions/generate.

default_message: Another version is already running in shadow. Promote or clear it first, or accept with replace_shadow: true to replace it.
template: {policy} v{n} is already running in shadow. Promote or clear it first, or accept with replace_shadow: true to replace it.

default_message: This suggestion was already decided. Look at its status, or generate suggestions again.
template: This suggestion was already accepted on {date} by {who}. It created {policy} v{n}.
